Rashi on Bava Batra 25a:10:2.english: To all the directions he stood us - He stood me up to pray.

Rashi on Bava Batra 25a:10:3.english: Because the heretics have ruled on it - The disciples of idol worshippers issue a ruling [that one should] pray toward the east:

Rashi on Bava Batra 25a:11:1.hebrew: אוריה - אני שמעתי כך קורין למערב בלשון פרסי. ול"נ שכך קורין למזרח בלשון לעז, והיינו דקאמר אויר יה, שהשכינה במערב ופניו למזרח, נמצא המזרח אוירו:
Rashi on Bava Batra 25a:11:1.english: Uriah - I heard that this is how they call the west in the Persian language. But it seems to me [ול"נ] that this is how they call the east in the foreign tongue (la'az). And this is what [the Gemara] means when it says "the air of Yah" (avir Yah): the Divine Presence is in the west and one's face is toward the east, so it turns out that the east is its air.

Rashi on Bava Batra 25a:12:1.hebrew: יערוף כמטר לקחי - משה רבינו דימה את התורה לארבע רוחות: כשם שאי אפשר בלא הם, כך אי אפשר לעולם בלא תורה:
Rashi on Bava Batra 25a:12:1.english: May my teaching drop like the rain - Moses our teacher likened the Torah to the four winds: just as it is impossible [for the world to exist] without them, so too it is impossible for the world [to exist] without Torah.

Rashi on Bava Batra 25a:12:2.hebrew: מערפו של עולם - אני שמעתי: מחזקו של עולם, על שם שהשכינה במערב ס"ל. ואני אומר: מאחוריו של עולם, שהמערב קרוי אחור, שנאמר "הן קדם אהלך ואיננו, ואחור ולא אבין" וגו' (איוב כ״ג:ח׳):
Rashi on Bava Batra 25a:12:2.english: From the nape of the world - I heard [the explanation]: from the strength of the world, because he holds that the Divine Presence is in the west. But I say: from the back of the world, for the west is called "behind," as it is stated: "Behold, I go forward, but He is not there; and backward, but I cannot perceive Him," etc. (Job 23:8)

Rashi on Bava Batra 25a:13:1.hebrew: שמזלת את הזהב - שמחממת ומביאה שרב ורעבון, בא והזהב זל:
Rashi on Bava Batra 25a:13:1.english: That causes the gold to depreciate - For it heats and brings scorching heat and famine; [people sell their gold to buy food,] and the gold becomes cheap.

Rashi on Bava Batra 25a:13:2.english: And so it says - For it is written [an expression of] zilusa (pouring out) with regard to gold [Isaiah 46:6: "Those who lavish (hazzalim) gold from the purse"].

Rashi on Bava Batra 25a:1:1.hebrew: שעושה אותו גלל - מרבה לו זבל, ושורף את הזרעים שנזרעו בו:
Rashi on Bava Batra 25a:1:1.english: That he makes it into dung - He increases dung for it [the field], and it burns the seeds that were sown in it.

Rashi on Bava Batra 25a:2:1.english: The carcasses and the graves, etc. - Because of the bad smell.

Rashi on Bava Batra 25a:2:2.hebrew: אלא למזרח העיר - שאין הרוח מזרחית קשה תדיר אא"כ באה לפורענות, אבל כדרכה היא חמה ומנשבת בנחת, דכתיב (יונה ד׳:ח׳) רוח קדים חרישית, ותך השמש וגו'. לפיכך אינה מביאה הרוח לעיר:
Rashi on Bava Batra 25a:2:2.english: Except to the east of the city - For the east wind is not constantly harsh unless it comes for punishment; rather, in its usual manner it is hot and blows gently, as it is written (Jonah 4:8): "A silent east wind, and the sun beat down, etc." Therefore, the wind does not bring [the odor] to the city.

Rashi on Bava Batra 25a:2:3.hebrew: חוץ מן מערבה - בגמ' מפרש טעמא:
Rashi on Bava Batra 25a:2:3.english: Except for its west [side] - In the Gemara, [the reason] is explained.

Rashi on Bava Batra 25a:3:1.hebrew: וסומך - אינו צריך להרחיק חמשים אמה:
Rashi on Bava Batra 25a:3:1.english: And adjacent - [The tanner] does not need to distance [the tannery] fifty cubits.

Rashi on Bava Batra 25a:3:2.hebrew: שאינו עושה כלל - ומרחיק נ' אמה, דקאמר ר"ע אשאר רוחות דרישא קאי:
Rashi on Bava Batra 25a:3:2.english: That he does not make [one] at all - And he distances [it] fifty cubits, for when R"A [Rabbi Akiva] said [this], he was referring to the other directions in the first clause.

Rashi on Bava Batra 25a:5:1.hebrew: תדירא ברוחות - אותו צד תדיר ברוח, שרוח מערבית מנשבת תדיר משאר רוחות:
Rashi on Bava Batra 25a:5:1.english: Frequent among the winds - That side is the frequent one among the winds, for the west wind blows more frequently than the other winds.

Rashi on Bava Batra 25a:5:2.hebrew: רוח צפונית מנשבת עם כל אחת - מהרוחות, לפי שהיא רכה ומתוקה וצלולה, כדאמר ביבמות (דף עב.): וממתקתן:
Rashi on Bava Batra 25a:5:2.english: The north wind blows together with each one - of the [other] winds, because it is soft, sweet, and clear, as it says in Yevamot (72a): "and it sweetens them."

Rashi on Bava Batra 25a:5:3.hebrew: בן נץ - מלאך העשוי בדמות נץ:
Rashi on Bava Batra 25a:5:3.english: A son of a hawk - An angel made in the form of a hawk.

Rashi on Bava Batra 25a:5:4.english: Makes it stand - with its wings.

Rashi on Bava Batra 25a:6:1.english: Frequent with the Divine Presence - The Divine Presence dwells in the west.

Rashi on Bava Batra 25a:6:2.english: For our forefathers - The men of the Great Assembly, who stated this verse in the book of Ezra.

Rashi on Bava Batra 25a:6:3.hebrew: וצבא השמים - השמש והירח העומדים במזרח:
Rashi on Bava Batra 25a:6:3.english: And the host of heaven - The sun and the moon, which stand in the east.

Rashi on Bava Batra 25a:6:4.english: To You we bow - Toward the west.

Rashi on Bava Batra 25a:7:1.hebrew: ודלמא - הם למזרח משתחוים. וכי תימא אין דרך להשתחוות סמוך לרב — הם עושין כעבד שנטל פרס מרבו, וחוזר לאחוריו ומשתחוה כשהוא הולך לאחוריו. משנטל פרס, מתרחק תמיד בהשתחויה:
Rashi on Bava Batra 25a:7:1.english: And perhaps - They are bowing toward the east. And if you say that it is not customary to bow close to one's master — they act like a servant who has taken leave of his master and goes backward, bowing as he walks backward. Once he has taken leave, he keeps moving farther away, bowing continually.

Rashi on Bava Batra 25a:8:1.hebrew: אתה הוא ה' לבדך - בתר "וצבא השמים" כתיב, ועל עסקי שליחות צבא השמים הוא משבח ואומר: "אתה הוא לבדך" במדה זו:
Rashi on Bava Batra 25a:8:1.english: You are the Lord, You alone - After it, "and the host of heaven" is written, and concerning the matter of the mission of the host of heaven, he offers praise and says, "You are He, You alone," in this manner.

Rashi on Bava Batra 25a:8:2.hebrew: לשם מחזירין שליחותן - כשבאין לומר "עשינו שליחותך", צריכין לשוב אל מקום שהשולחם עומד שם:
Rashi on Bava Batra 25a:8:2.english: To there they return their mission - When they come to say, "We have done your errand," they must return to the place where the one who sent them is standing.

Rashi on Bava Batra 25a:8:3.hebrew: למקום שמשתלחין - פי' באותו מקום שנשתלחו שם, אף שם השכינה מצויה ואומרים לו: עשינו שליחותך:
Rashi on Bava Batra 25a:8:3.english: To the place where they are sent - Its explanation: in that place to which they were sent, there too the Divine Presence is found, and they say to Him, "We have done Your mission."

Rashi on Bava Batra 25a:9:1.hebrew: והנה המלאך הדובר בי יוצא - בנבואת זכריה: "למוד את ירושלים, כמה ארכה" וגו'. ומלאך אחר יוצא לסתור שליחותו של ראשון, שחזר בו המקום ולא יתן בה מדה, ואומר: "פרזות תשב ירושלים". והרי שניהם מאת השכינה באים, ו"אחריו" לא נאמר אלא "לקראתו" — זה בא מכאן וזה בא מכאן:
Rashi on Bava Batra 25a:9:1.english: And behold, the angel who spoke with me went out - In the prophecy of Zechariah: "To measure Jerusalem, how much is its length," etc. And another angel goes out to undo the mission of the first, [saying] that the Omnipresent had changed His mind and [the first angel] should not take a measure of it, and he says: "Jerusalem shall be inhabited as unwalled villages." And behold, both of them come from the Shechinah, and it is not said "after him" but rather "to meet him" — this one comes from here and that one comes from there:

Tosafot on Bava Batra 25a:10:1.hebrew: לכל רוחתא אוקמן - כל הני אמוראי לית להו הא דתניא בברכות (דף ל.), שחייב אדם להתפלל נגד ירושלים משום דכתיב: "והתפללו אליך דרך ארצם". אלא סברי כר' ישמעאל דאמר: בכ"מ שכינה. ומאן דאמר שכינה במערב, סבר כר"ע דאמר: מפני שהיא תדירה. ור' חנינא דשמעתין דאמר: כגון אתון דיתבון לצפונא דארעא דישראל, אדרימו — סבר לה כברייתא דברכות:
Tosafot on Bava Batra 25a:10:1.english: "We have established it as [applying to] every direction" - All these Amoraim do not hold [by] that which is taught in Berakhot (30a), that a person is obligated to pray facing Jerusalem, because it is written: "And they shall pray to You by way of their land" (I Kings 8:48). Rather, they hold like Rabbi Yishmael, who said: The Divine Presence is in every place. And the one who said that the Divine Presence is in the west holds like Rabbi Akiva, who said: Because it is constant. And Rabbi Chanina of our passage, who said: For example, you who dwell in the north of the Land of Israel, [turn] to the south — holds like the baraita in Berakhot.

Tosafot on Bava Batra 25a:11:1.hebrew: אוריה - לשון שפ"ה: דאוריה מערב. נראה לר"ת, ולר"ח עיקר:
Tosafot on Bava Batra 25a:11:1.english: Oriyah - The wording of [Rashi] is that Oriyah means west. [This] appears correct to Rabbeinu Tam, and to Rabbeinu Chananel [it is] the primary [explanation]:

Tosafot on Bava Batra 25a:12:1.hebrew: רוח מערבית שבא מערפו של עולם - כדפי' בקונט' מאחורו של עולם, דמערב קרוי אחור, דכתיב: "אחור וקדם צרתני", ודרשינן [בחגיגה] (דף יב.) לענין מזרח ומערב. וכתיב נמי: "ארם מקדם ופלשתים מאחור" (ישעיהו ט׳:י״א). וקרי נמי דרום ימין ולצפון שמאל, כדאמרי' בשמעתין. והיינו משום דשכינה במערב, ופני השכינה למזרח; לכך קרוי מערב אחור, ומזרח קדם, ודרום ימין, וצפון שמאל. ולמ"ד שכינה בכל מקום, צ"ל דהאי דקרי מזרח קדם, ומערב אחור, ודרום ימין, וצפון שמאל — משום שכינה בבית המקדש שהיה במערב, ופני השכינה כלפי ישראל שהיו במזרח ומשתחוים שם: הגה"ה: ורבינו יצחק בר יהודה פירש דכשעמד אדם הראשון כשנברא היו פניו למזרח, ואין נראה שהיה ערפו כלפי השכינה למאן דאמר שכינה במערב. ע"כ הגה"ה:
Tosafot on Bava Batra 25a:12:1.english: The west wind, which comes from the nape of the world - As explained in the Kuntres [Rashi]: From the back of the world, for the west is called "back," as it is written: "Behind and before You have formed me" (Psalms 139:5), and we expound this in [Tractate Chagigah] (12a) as referring to east and west. And it is also written: "Aram from the east, and the Philistines from behind" (Isaiah 9:11). And south is likewise called "right" and north "left," as we say in our passage. And this is because the Divine Presence is in the west, and the face of the Divine Presence is toward the east; therefore the west is called "back," the east "front," the south "right," and the north "left." And according to the one who says that the Divine Presence is everywhere, one must say that the reason the east is called "front," the west "back," the south "right," and the north "left" is on account of the Divine Presence in the Temple, which was in the west, with the face of the Divine Presence toward Israel, who were in the east and would bow down there. Gloss: And Rabbeinu Yitzchak bar Yehuda explained that when Adam, the first man, stood up upon being created, his face was toward the east, and it does not seem that his nape would have been toward the Divine Presence, according to the one who says that the Divine Presence is in the west. End of gloss.

Tosafot on Bava Batra 25a:14:1.hebrew: רוח מזרחית שמסערת כל העולם כולו - והא דמשמע במתניתין שהיא נוחה מכל הרוחות, היינו כשהיא באה כדרכה; אבל כשבאה לפורענות, היא מסערת, כדפי' הקונט' במתניתין:
Tosafot on Bava Batra 25a:14:1.english: The east wind, which storms the entire world - And as for what is implied in the Mishnah, that it is the most pleasant of all the winds, that is when it comes in its normal manner; but when it comes for punishment, it storms, as I (Rashi) explained in the Mishnah.

Tosafot on Bava Batra 25a:1:1.hebrew: שעושה אותו גלל - אע"ג דגלל משביח הקרקע, כשהיא כולה גלל מזיק:
Tosafot on Bava Batra 25a:1:1.english: That he makes it into a pile of dung - Even though dung improves the soil, when it is entirely dung, it is harmful:

Tosafot on Bava Batra 25a:2:1.hebrew: אין עושין בורסקי אלא למזרח העיר - משום דרוח מערבי שהוא קשה, ירחיק ויוליך הריח מן העיר, כדאמרי' (ברכות מ.): הישן למזרח גרנו, דמו בראשו, מפני שרוח מערבית מביא הקש בחוטמו:
Tosafot on Bava Batra 25a:2:1.english: "One may make a tannery only to the east of the city" - Because the west wind, which is strong, will carry the smell far away from the city, as we say (Berakhot 40a): "One who sleeps with his throat to the east, his blood is on his own head, because the west wind brings the straw into his nose."

Tosafot on Bava Batra 25a:4:1.hebrew: מפני שהיא תדירה - לא גרסי': מ"ט, דמן הברייתא היא, דהכי איתא בתוספתא (פ"א ע"ש):
Tosafot on Bava Batra 25a:4:1.english: "Because it is frequent" - We do not have the reading "What is the reason?", for it is [part] of the baraita itself, as it is stated this way in the Tosefta (chapter 1, see there):

Tosafot on Bava Batra 25a:6:1.hebrew: וצבא השמים לך משתחוים - וא"ת: בלילה נמי במזרח משתחוים? וי"ל: דאין לנו ללמוד אלא ממה שאנו רואין. וא"ת: ואמאי לא נדע מקום תפלה מבית המקדש שהיתה שם שכינה במערב? וי"ל: דמשם אין ללמוד, דאע"ג דשכינה בכל מקום, אי אפשר להשים ארון וכפורת אלא בצד אחד. וריצב"א אומר: דמשם אין ללמוד דשכינה במערב, דנהי דבית קדשי הקדשים היה במערב המקדש, מ"מ הארון שהשכינה שם, כדכתיב (שמות כה): "ונועדתי לך שם", היה במזרח בית קדשי הקדשים:
Tosafot on Bava Batra 25a:6:1.english: "And the host of heaven bows down to You" - And if you ask: At night, too, [the heavenly bodies] bow down in the east? And one can answer: We have nothing to learn from except what we see. And if you ask: Why don't we learn the direction of prayer from the Temple, where the Divine Presence was in the west? And one can answer: One cannot learn from there, for even though the Divine Presence is everywhere, it is impossible to place the Ark and the cover except on one side. And the Rizba says: One cannot learn from there that the Divine Presence is in the west, for granted that the Holy of Holies was in the west of the Temple, nevertheless the Ark, where the Divine Presence was, as it is written (Exodus 25): "And I will meet with you there," was in the east of the Holy of Holies:
